Raw rocktail can yield roughly 315,000 experience per hour; with decorated cooking urns, this increases to 378,000 experience per hour. 
Raw rocktails stop burning only if wearing cooking gauntlets at level 94 or using the Cooking cape perk. 
A series of tests were conducted with cooking gauntlets equipped, at the minimum level to cook them (93), yielding a burn rate of:
• 27 rocktails out of 3,969 (0.68%) 
• 18 rocktails out of 2,176 (0.83%)
Without cooking gauntlets, rocktails burn at high rates, even with a Cooking level boosted to 103 using a Chef's delight.

It is universally advised to only use this in combination with restore, super restore, or overload potions in order to counteract the draining of the player's Attack, Strength, Magic and Ranged stats. Without using restore potions, the Saradomin brew will reduce a player's levels to under level 10 within 5-8 doses, depending on the player's stats. As this effectively defeats the point of using it by quickly rendering players nearly incapable of doing damage, it is generally avoided.
In certain situations where the extra healing from a Saradomin brew is not fully required, the player can opt to use a Guthix rest potion instead to avoid the stat draining effect of Saradomin brews.
The brew has the fourth highest amount of healing per inventory slot, behind Super Saradomin brews, primal feasts, and a stack of purple sweets, and not including a calorie bomb (rocktail). While becoming largely useless immediately after the introduction of the Evolution of Combat due to their minuscule healing per dose, they became a staple of high level PvM upon their subsequent buff. They are almost always used at bosses such as Nex: Angel of Death, Beastmaster Durzag, and Yakamaru. As they do not provide large amounts of burst healing, they are generally used as a supplementary heal. Combined with a sailfish to "tick eat" (or "sailfish brew"), a player can heal 3,400 LP in a single tick by consuming both items in quick succession. Alternatively, by tick eating (or "jelly brewing") a blue blubber jellyfish, you can restore 1,750 LP in a single tick without losing adrenaline. Because of their decently expensive price, it is not suggested to use brews during low level PvM activities or most Slayer tasks.…
